Definition: from G1537 and G5453; to sprout up:--put forth.
BiblicalUsage: The word ekphýō carries the sense of put forth. In Matthew 24:32, the text says "and putteth forth leaves."
TheologicalSignificance: This word, ekphýō, does its job quietly — put forth — and I leave it at that.
RelatedTopics: Nature and Creation; Growth; Kingdom of God
